owner_direction: configurable $0.99 fee-inclusive completion ceiling for already-filled unmatched inventory behind a disabled-by-default flag; preserve the $0.96 opening ceiling; prioritise at-touch maker completion; lot-aware completion pricing; report hedging separately from profitable completion.
headline: THE PREMISE NEEDED CORRECTING FIRST: 0.96 was never the completion bound. `completion_pair_rescue` already permitted completions up to eff <= 1.00, and the venue record shows this engine submitting a complement at a pair of exactly 1.0000. What actually blocked completion was PLACEMENT -- the two-sided path priced the complement at the OPENING depth, resting it two ticks BELOW the touch and behind the entire visible queue. On authenticated evidence the at-touch change plus the lot-aware basis take admissible completions from 1 window of 4 to 2 of 4, and best-case locked margin from $0.084 to $0.124 against $2.96 of basis at risk. Every change defaults to today's behaviour; parity is unchanged.

lot_aware_pricing.why_it_matters_concretely: the live 2300z book held 3.3600 UP at an average own cost of 0.605 -- exactly 2 x 1.68 and exactly (0.21 + 1.00)/2: the venue-confirmed lot of 1.68 at own 0.2100 blended with a second lot carrying the 1.00 unattested-basis placeholder. 0.605 is a price neither lot ever traded at.
lot_aware_pricing.attestation_is_the_discriminator: only a real fill writes a fill_provenance entry, so quantity from `reconcile_from_venue`'s net has no lot. `position - attested_qty` names it.
lot_aware_pricing.honest_limit: attribution does not change total settled P&L -- contracts are fungible at settlement, so which lot a pair is matched against is an accounting choice. What lot-awareness fixes is the GATE reading a blended placeholder price and refusing (or admitting) on a number nothing traded at. This is shipped as readers and reporting; no gate consults them yet.

per_window.note: 4-sample slice; the full forensics showed 1.05-1.10 throughout

item6_ceiling_comparison_0_96_vs_0_99.reading: the ceiling adds ONE window and $0.0400. The lot-aware basis unlocks $0.0840 -- more than the ceiling does -- and the at-touch depth is what makes either fillable at all. At clip 2 over ~2 hours this is cents; against $480/day it is not a path, it is a correctness fix that stops the engine refusing on wrong numbers.

fill_rates.why: every venue-confirmed fill in the campaign is a FIRST leg. No completion has ever filled at any depth, so no fill rate for 0.96 or 0.99 is supported. Every figure above is ADMISSIBILITY and locked margin CONDITIONAL on a fill the displayed book does not guarantee.

item7_residual_risk_hedge_versus_profita.profitable_completion: the matched book locks a gain against the basis actually paid: pair < 1.00 means the completed pair redeems more than it cost. At 2245z that is $0.0400 and at 2300z $0.0840 -- confirmed, settled, realized money if the quote fills.
item7_residual_risk_hedge_versus_profita.hedge: forward variance reduction. Completing locks margin = 1 - basis - mk; holding the unmatched leg, marked at the same book, is worth (1 - mk) - basis. Those are the same expression, so completing at the prevailing complement price is EXACTLY EV-neutral against holding before fees, and negative after. This is algebra, not a sample statistic.
item7_residual_risk_hedge_versus_profita.so_a_hedge_is_not_rejected_for_being_unp: the two questions have different answers and both are true. 'Did this pair make money against what we paid?' -- yes, 2 to 5 cents a contract. 'Was completing better than holding?' -- neither better nor worse in expectation. For a CONFIRMED REALIZED profit target, converting an EV-neutral uncertain outcome into a locked small gain is exactly what the objective asks for, and it cuts the stranded-leg loss tail. What it does not do is create expected value, and nothing here reports it as if it did.
item7_residual_risk_hedge_versus_profita.the_tail_it_cuts: $2.9604 of basis sat at risk across the four windows. A stranded first leg settles at 0 or at its full quantity; completing removes that dispersion at a cost of the fee and of the upside tail.

go_no_go.decision: GO on the code, NO-GO on enabling it without the measurement
go_no_go.go_because: the complement-depth defect is real, venue-proven, already diagnosed elsewhere in this codebase, and fixed in three lines behind a default-off flag; the ceiling is now named, bounded and telemetered instead of implicit at 1.00; and the lot readers expose a blended placeholder that was hiding a window's only admissible completion.
go_no_go.no_go_because: no completion has ever filled, so the at-touch fill rate is unmeasured. Enabling at-touch completion is a bet that resting at the touch fills materially more often than resting two ticks back, and that number does not exist in any historical record because the venue publishes no per-order queue position.
go_no_go.not_authorized_here: no live orders, no arming, no enablement. The flags stay off until the owner approves a campaign scope.

bounded_live_validation_config.purpose: measure the at-touch completion fill rate against the depth-2 rate. That single unobservable gates every completion policy decision.

env_to_leave_alone.L5_MAX_WORST_CASE_DEFICIT_USD: unchanged -- the rescue answers to it

bounded_live_validation_config.design: alternate by window: depth 2 control, at-touch treatment. 20 windows, ~1.75 admissible moments a window on campaign evidence, so roughly 35 split ~17 per arm -- enough for a large difference, not a small one. A modest result is NOT RESOLVED, not a promotion.
